types.description: C60N miniature circuit breaker / 3P / 32 A / C curve

document.title: Schneider Electric Multi 9 — Sistema apparecchiature modulari
document.pages: Printed pp.14-15; Yumpu physical pages 16-17; diagram E45095 on p.15

modelingNotes: Exact 24287 selection: C60N, 3P, 32 A, curve C; catalog 2010-2011 printed pp.14-15. Manufacturer-authored catalog mirrored on Yumpu by carnevale.bz.
Six marked terminals: 1-2, 3-4, 5-6. Three mechanically ganged breaking poles; open state is the catalog drawing convention, not an asserted installed state. No permanent fixed links.

32 A rating at 30 degrees C; magnetic trip 5-10 In. Printed p.14 specifies Ue 400 V AC, Icn 6000 A at 400 V under CEI EN 60898; Icu 20 kA at 230-240 V and 10 kA at 400-415 V under CEI EN 60947-2 for 3P. Ui 500 V AC; Uimp 6 kV. No assigned circuit voltage or unconditional breaking-capacity scalar is modeled.
For 32-63 A ratings, cage terminals accept up to 25 mm2 flexible or 35 mm2 rigid conductors. Ratings page: https://img.yumpu.com/16219073/16/1500x2000/multi-9-sistema-apparecchiature-modulari.jpg

Base breaker only: no accessory auxiliary contacts, trip-release terminals, neutral, PE, shield or communications connections in this order inventory. No phase names or feed orientation inferred. External use is application-dependent, so no terminal is universally required.

connectionCoverage.notes: All six base-breaker power terminals are modeled from the exact selection-table diagram E45095. Separately ordered accessories are excluded.
